steps.what: Record work activities, locations, materials and relevant observations
Check the activity record and confirm accurate completion details

tasks.design: Configure a compact mobile work form in {OTHER}, the field service records system, using existing job details and an explicit activity checklist. The technician enters what actually happened and checks the exact completed record; no treatment narrative or chemical use is inferred.
tasks.previous_blocker: Handwritten records repeat job headers and common activity descriptions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native mobile forms can reuse job headers and approved activity labels.
tasks.still_hard: Unusual findings and material quantities still require careful entry and checking.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish completed work from planned work and record material deviations accurately.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less repetitive form writing; record accountability remains unchanged.

reach.task: Review complete and accurate service records

evidence.claim: Native mobile forms can reduce repeated headers and standard wording; this is E1 model knowledge with no digest case.

assumptions: Boundary is recording and checking completed work, excluding inspection, treatment selection and physical pest-control work.

The technician produces job ID, visit date, actual activity, treated location, material identifier and actual quantity where relevant, findings and deviations in s1. Its 56 retained hours explicitly include field capture, label reading and free-text exceptions; inputs are not assumed structured for free.

The dispatcher supplies existing job ID, address and planned visit information through the current job process. The technician verifies the header; absent or wrong details require manual correction in s1 and s2.
Test native forms before custom code. No automatic completion flag or chemical application amount is generated; actual entry and all final review remain counted.
unknowns: Current record format and native mobile support
Required local record fields and offline needs
research_questions: Does the form reduce repeated writing after counting every actual observation and material entry?

already_counted.description: Actual work capture, exceptions and final record verification

incremental.description: Maintain form labels and investigate record exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact visit, performed activities, locations, materials, quantities, findings and deviations; edits require renewed confirmation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=56+30=86; gross 14%, minus three focal upkeep gives 11% central net. Low assumes five repetitive-writing hours removable when most findings remain free text; actual capture and all final checking remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend pest treatment and prevention to clients

steps.what: Assess suitable treatment and prevention methods for the client's pest problem
Recommend methods and explain precautions and prevention responsibilities to clients

tasks.design: Keep treatment suitability and the client recommendation with the technician. Approved guidance in {DOCS} supports discussion; no automatic pesticide choice or personal advice generator is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: The appropriate method depends on infestation, site use and risks to people or animals.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing approved guidance already supports the retained professional decision.
tasks.still_hard: A technically effective treatment may be unsuitable for the occupied site.
tasks.human_edge: Explain realistic options and site-specific precautions in terms the client understands.
tasks.altitude: Recommendation time and responsibility remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Site-specific treatment recommendations and client explanation retain their labour in this design.

assumptions: Boundary is adapting an established treatment approach to the client and explaining prevention; preliminary report-based method determination is assigned to task 7983. The same technical selection must be allocated once in a roll-up.
No new structured pest-risk score or automated treatment recommendation is introduced.
Existing native approved guidance suffices. No deployment or additional maintenance is added, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Approved treatment methods and technician authority
research_questions: Can the client explain the recommended precautions and prevention responsibilities?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, zero gross and net saving. Site-specific judgement and client conversation remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct or assist workers during pest treatment

steps.what: Direct or assist workers in treatment and extermination processes

tasks.design: Keep on-site direction and physical assistance with the technician. Existing instructions in {DOCS} remain available, without a new remote-control or automated worker-direction tool.
tasks.previous_blocker: Treatment requires coordinated physical action under changing site conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: No software change removes the need for direct assistance and safe coordination.
tasks.still_hard: A worker may encounter an obstruction or exposure concern not apparent in the plan.
tasks.human_edge: Notice unsafe conditions and coordinate an immediate appropriate response.
tasks.altitude: On-site direction and assistance retain the same time and authority.

evidence.claim: Live treatment coordination and physical assistance retain all labour in this design.

assumptions: Boundary is this technician's direction and assistance; other workers' treatment labour is outside the focal denominator and unchanged.
No automated step needs a new structured readiness or treatment-completion flag.
Existing native instruction access suffices. No deployment or upkeep is added, justifying zero incremental work.
unknowns: Team responsibilities and site access conditions
research_questions: Which treatment stages require direct supervision or additional assistance?

already_counted.description: On-site direction, assistance and safety response

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; zero gross saving and zero upkeep. Physical assistance and live direction remain full.

tasks.short: Study infestation reports and determine treatment

steps.what: Study preliminary reports and diagrams of the infested area
Determine the treatment type and measures to prevent recurrence

tasks.design: Keep interpretation of reports, diagrams and treatment choices with the technician using approved references in {DOCS}. No model extracts a treatment command from an incomplete infestation description.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reports and diagrams may omit critical site or pest context.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing source documents already support professional interpretation.
tasks.still_hard: Preventing recurrence depends on causes and access routes as well as the observed pest.
tasks.human_edge: Connect infestation evidence to a suitable technical approach and recognise missing information.
tasks.altitude: Technical treatment-selection time and responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Site diagrams, pest identification and missing-data escalation

evidence.claim: Report interpretation and technical treatment determination retain their labour; no automated safety-critical choice is claimed.

assumptions: Boundary is preliminary source review and technical method selection, excluding later client explanation, field treatment and work recording. Duplicate selection with task 20759 must be allocated once in the roll-up.
Existing survey staff produce reports and diagrams through their present process. No new structured infestation code is required.
Existing native document access suffices. No system or process change is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Preliminary report quality and decision authority
research_questions: Which missing report details require another inspection before choosing treatment?

already_counted.description: Source interpretation and technical treatment selection

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; zero gross saving and zero upkeep. Source interpretation and technical judgement remain full.
